 Raynham Police Department Thanks First Responders and Public Safety Partners on National First Responders Day
 October 28, 2026 
 National First Responders Day, observed Oct. 28, recognizes police officers, firefighters, EMTs, paramedics and 911 dispatchers for their service to their communities.
We thank our members and public safety partners for the work they do every day to help keep our community safe. We appreciate their dedication and the support they provide to one another, both during emergencies and in their daily work. 
We also remember the first responders who have died in the line of duty and the families, friends and colleagues who carry their loss.
